name: Now Playing
summary: Shows what is playing, in Spotify, Music, YouTube and more, when the volume or the track changes.
trigger: Changing the volume, or a new track starting

settings.title: Show when a new track starts

Spotify and Music tell Mantel about each track themselves. Other players, such as YouTube in a browser, are read from what macOS shows as Now Playing. That part of macOS is not documented by Apple, so it may stop working after a macOS update; Spotify and Music would still work.
